subject: Evaluation & MAP: security acceptance criteria and DPA redline
messages:

Cc: procurement@albatrossbank.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & initial security asks

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the intros on the call last week. We're ready to formalize a mutual action plan (MAP) for the evaluation and procurement cadence. To keep procurement moving we need: 

- SOC 2 report (latest, with scope notes) or attestation timeline
- Completed SIG/CAIQ or confirmation that Redwood can provide a self-attested CAIQ initially
- DPA redline (we can share our standard with comments)
- Data retention tiers and encryption-at-rest/in-transit confirmation

I've attached a rough MAP spreadsheet showing our desired milestones (attachment: procurement_timeline.pdf). Can we target a review of the DPA redline by the end of next week?

Procurement preference: we like to see explicit data residency and retention windows in the DPA (especially for sandbox vs production).

Looking forward — if it helps we can book a short follow-up call Tuesday to walk the MAP.

Best,
Emma Wright
Senior PM, Security Programs
Albatross Bank

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a draft MAP (albatross_map_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria. High level responses here so procurement can move: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security) — we will share the report under NDA. Timing: we can provide the latest report within 48 hours of your NDA confirmation.
- CAIQ/SIG: We maintain a full CAIQ; we can provide a self-attested CAIQ for the initial eval. If you need the complete SIG matrix, we'll prioritize a filled export — ETA 7 business days.
- DPA: Thanks for sharing your standard. Marcus (legal/ops) will lead the redline and coordinate with our legal team.
- Data retention & residency: See MAP tab "Retention" — we call out sandbox 30 days, staging 90 days, production configurable (default 365 days) with options for shorter windows. Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit; KMS integration available for private deployments.

Suggested next steps:
1) You share NDA or confirm HubSpot record for report delivery.
2) Marcus and Neha will review DPA redlines and return a first pass in 3 business days.
3) Book a 30-minute sync to finalize acceptance criteria and timing.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the SOC 2 intake and whether CAIQ can be self-attested for now?

Thanks — 
Stephanie Nguyen

Stephanie / Emma — looping in a few clarifications from legal/infra to make sure acceptance criteria in the MAP are actionable: 

On Tue, Nov 16, 2026 at 10:38 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> - SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security) — we will share the report under NDA. Timing: we can provide the latest report within 48 hours of your NDA confirmation.

Notes from Legal/Infra: 
- SOC 2 scope: our current SOC 2 covers production inference and control plane for hosted and dedicated deployments; it does NOT cover customer-managed on-prem packages. We should make that explicit in the MAP under "Scope & Exclusions."
- CAIQ approach: self-attested CAIQ for the eval is acceptable where customers need speed; however, for enterprise procurement we recommend providing the completed SIG export within the MAP timeline (we can commit to 7 business days after NDA).
- DPA redline: we'll return a version with a minimal set of carve-outs — primary asks from Albatross we expect to discuss: data residency clauses, deletion certification language, and subprocessor list. Legal will target a first-pass redline by Friday COB.
- Retention tiers (explicit): Sandbox = 30 days (rolling), Staging = 90 days (rolling), Production default = 365 days; retention can be shortened by contract or via API in Dedicated/Private deployments. We'll add a short clause in the MAP describing the deletion lifecycle and methods for customers to request bulk deletion or escrow.

Action items assigned: 
- Marcus: produce DPA redline and include subprocessor list (target: 2026-11-19 COB).
- Neha: prepare CAIQ export and CAIQ self-attest summary for Albatross (target: 2026-11-23).
- Stephanie: deliver MAP spreadsheet with updated "Scope" and "Retention" text (updated version attached after edits).

Marcus Lin
Director, Product Security Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment note: internal redline will be attached to the HubSpot record and sent to Emma once internal review is complete.

Quick calendar note: procurement's preferred signoff window is 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-07. If Redwood can commit to SOC 2 + DPA redline by 2026-11-24, that puts us on track.
